source: The opposite strategy can also backfire. Forcing a compiler to use fewer registers may increase occupancy, yet create extra local-memory traffic because values no longer fit in register state. In that case a kernel may gain more resident warps but do more memory work per warp.
zh: 相反的策略也可能适得其反。强制编译器使用更少的寄存器可能会增加占用率，但会产生额外的本地内存流量，因为值不再适合寄存器状态。在这种情况下，内核可能会获得更多常驻扭曲，但每个扭曲会执行更多内存工作。
